limits: The identified set is conditional on the true receiver being among the visible candidates; the cohort hides candidates, so the true set can only be wider. The bound is optimistic in the direction of precision.
The bound is not a confidence interval: it carries no sampling error and is reported beside the CI, never combined with it.
Every pairing is an INFERENCE. The dataset records no opponent identifier, so no output here says which man was covered.
two_candidate_separation_gap_yd is MAX(sep) - MIN(sep) of the candidates' separation values. It is not a distance between two players.
Nothing here enters TASK.md, the band table, the four figures or the report draft. TASK.md forbids outcome tests; this is a diagnostic on an estimator TASK.md already excludes.
